name: Bathroom

photos.caption: From the doorway: back-to-wall WC with concealed cistern, black-framed sliding shower, small square basin
Through the old panelled door: pink ceiling, disco ball, vertical tiles in the shower

current.summary: Newly fitted small shower room. Black-framed sliding glass shower enclosure over a dark slate-effect tray with a black thermostatic rain-shower set; walls tiled in narrow vertical stacked tiles in a soft blush-white (zellige look) in the shower, large grey stone-effect tiles elsewhere; floor in large light-grey tiles. Back-to-wall WC with concealed cistern and white flush plate; small square wall-hung basin with a black tap. Black wire shelving, a cluster of Edison-bulb wall lights, a disco ball on a pink-painted ceiling. Entered through an old painted panelled door with ornate brass handles.
keep: Shower enclosure, tray and black fittings — new and good
Old panelled door with brass furniture — strip and repaint, it has character
The pink ceiling and disco ball, if it makes you smile — it's that kind of room
issues: Basin waste is an exposed white flexible pipe — replace with a proper black bottle trap or a small vanity shelf to hide it
Door frame and wall reveal on the kitchen side unfinished (broken plaster)
No window visible — check there is a working extractor fan
Black fittings + brass handles + white plate — choose one metal finish going forward

orientation: Front corner of the top floor, at the end of the kitchen beside the appliance bay. Window or extractor fan — to confirm

target.concept: DRAFT — finish what's there rather than redo it: hide the basin plumbing under a small timber or stone shelf, a round mirror with an aged-brass frame, one good warm wall light, a black or brass towel rail and hooks, and finish the door and its frame. Keep the pink if you love it — it works with terracotta and the blush tiles.

target.renderPrompt: Photorealistic interior photograph, same camera angle, same room geometry, same windows, doors, beams and walls — do not move or invent architecture. Remove ALL clutter: boxes, tools, clothes, bags, bottles, cables, packaging. Restyle as a finished tiny shower room. Keep the black-framed sliding shower enclosure, dark shower tray, black shower set and the vertical blush-white tiles, keep the white back-to-wall WC. Hide the basin plumbing with a small oak shelf under the square basin, add a round aged-brass framed mirror above it, one warm wall light, a black towel rail with a natural linen towel. Paint the old panelled door and its frame in warm white eggshell, keep its brass handles; the ceiling in a soft dusty pink. Tidy, calm, boutique-hotel feel, no people.
